name: DisplaySelectDateDialogNode
label: Display Select Date Dialog
description: Displays a dialog box that prompts the user to enter a date or date range.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: DialogTitle
fields.label: Dialog Title
fields.description: The title text displayed at the top of the date dialog.

fields.name: DialogMessage
fields.label: Dialog Message
fields.description: The message displayed in the date dialog.

fields.name: DialogType
fields.label: Dialog Type
fields.description: Specifies whether the dialog prompts for a single date or a date range.

selectOptions.label: Single Date
selectOptions.description: Allows selection of a single date.

selectOptions.label: Date Range
selectOptions.description: Allows selection of a start and end date.

fields.name: PromptFor
fields.label: Prompt For
fields.description: Specifies whether to prompt for date only or date and time.

selectOptions.label: Date Only
selectOptions.description: Prompts the user to select a date only.

selectOptions.label: Date and Time
selectOptions.description: Prompts the user to select both date and time.

fields.name: KeepOnTop
fields.label: Keep Date Selection Dialog Always On Top
fields.description: If true, the dialog stays on top of other windows.

fields.name: SelectedDate
fields.label: Selected Date
fields.description: The date or date range selected by the user.

fields.name: ButtonPressed
fields.label: Button Pressed
fields.description: Indicates whether the OK or Cancel button was pressed.
